description: Workstream definition — one per-entry file per strategic workstream in the render-from-queue project-tracker store. Rewritten atomically (write-temp + rename, single writer, low-contention assumption); status/deliverable-completion mutations are field-scoped events (see workstream-event.schema.json), never in-place definition edits. Spec backlink: docs/plans/2026-07-08-project-tracker-render-from-queue.md § Approach / § Substrate (definitions) / § Chunks C2.

workstream_id.description: Stable identifier for this workstream; also the filename stem (state/workstreams/<workstream_id>.yaml). Immutable once minted.

title.description: Human-readable workstream name, as rendered in docs/project-tracker.md's numbered-list heading.

created.description: Date the workstream was created (YYYY-MM-DD). Part of the render-order tiebreaker: (created, workstream_id) per § Approach finding 3.

coordinator_root_path.description: Dual-tenant discriminator — the git root path of the repo this workstream belongs to. Folded from claude-klabauter-em constraints memo (2026-07-08): the physical directory <claude-klabauter>/state/workstreams/ is dual-tenant when the git root is the meta-repo (co-mingles the meta-repo's routed workstreams with claude-klabauter's own). The generator (C3) filters by this field so each repo's render includes ONLY its own entries — never the co-tenant's. Same discriminator vocabulary claude-klabauter's trackers.py already uses (composite-natural-key component).

deliverables.description: Ordered list of deliverable slots for this workstream. Completion state is NOT recorded here — it is a field-scoped event (field: 'deliverable[i].done') per the definition/event boundary (finding 6). Adding a new slot is a definition edit (rare); checking an existing one is an event (frequent). The generator's fold is union-tolerant: an event referencing a slot not yet present in a stale definition snapshot renders as a pending/orphan line rather than being silently dropped.

text.description: Deliverable description, as rendered in the tracker's checkbox line.

specs.description: Spec links associated with this workstream (paths under docs/plans/, docs/decisions/, etc.).

dependency_annotations.description: Free-text dependency notes carried forward from the hand-edited tracker format (e.g. 'blocked by X', 'depends on Y').
